answers.description: PragmaSpan is a training-free, few-shot GPT-5.5 span-error detector wrapped in a reliability-oriented inference and submission harness. References are included as optional prompt context when provided, and provided ASR transcripts are used as text context for speech items; video and screenshots are not consumed. The harness converts structured API responses into complete, deterministic, format-valid WMT26 Task 1 artifacts through truncation-aware row retries, conservative JSON and offset recovery, deterministic exact-span deduplication, exact item/system completeness checks against the official input, and mandatory validation before packaging. These safeguards target artifact reliability rather than claiming to improve diagnostic accuracy. The detector uses a seven-axis diagnostic taxonomy covering semantic, linguistic, discourse, and interpersonal errors; an ablation found that its four pragmatic axes provide interpretive structure but change detection accuracy by at most ±0.001 F on the evaluated domain mix. Model and prompt choices were evaluated against WMT25 ESA surrogate gold and WMT22 MQM en-de using the official severity-weighted MPP metric, and several prompt, span, and severity refinements were tested but excluded after failing to improve consistently across benchmarks.
answers.name: PragmaSpan
answers.reference_usage: The submitted directions use the provided pseudo references for English-Indonesian and the provided references labeled undefined for the English-Korean QEbreak set. Reference text is included as optional prompt context when present; the system does not otherwise treat reference types differently and remains functional without a reference. No native or postedit references are used in this submission.
